b_roll: Archival photo of Edgar Morin in Paris

sections.voiceover: On May 29, 2026, the French philosopher died in Paris. UNESCO honored his lifelong philosophical contributions at their headquarters in Paris. Where did his monumental series La Méthode change thought?
That masterpiece took 30 years to publish.
He built complex thought across generations. Paris witnessed his historic life as a resistance veteran. At 104 years old, he remained the last survivor of his era.

sections.voiceover: UNESCO hosted his centenary lecture in Paris.
